{"edits":[
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M3","pin":"Gate","net":"net1","why":"The pin at the left bar of M3 is its gate, and it joins the M6 diode-connected mirror node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M3","pin":"Source","net":"VDD","why":"The top terminal of M3 is the source and goes to VDD"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M3","pin":"Drain","net":"net3","why":"The bottom terminal of M3 is the drain and feeds the tail node of the input pair"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M2","pin":"Gate","net":"net1","why":"The M4 gate (pipeline M2) ties to the mirror gate line, not to the tail node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M5","pin":"Source","net":"net3","why":"The M11 source connects to the tail node, not VDD"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M5","pin":"Drain","net":"netA","why":"The M11 drain goes to the M21 diode-connected node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M4","pin":"Source","net":"net3","why":"The M12 source connects to the tail node, not VDD"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M4","pin":"Gate","net":"VINP","why":"The M12 gate is the VINP input"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M4","pin":"Drain","net":"net4","why":"The M12 drain joins the M22 drain, the M5 gate and C1"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M7","pin":"Drain","net":"netA"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M7","pin":"Gate","net":"netA"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M8","pin":"Gate","net":"netA","why":"The M22 gate is the mirror node shared with M21"}
]}

I'm checking the pipeline netlist against the image labels, since the component names don't line up. The pipeline uses M1 through M10, while the image uses names like M6, M11, and Ib, so I'll need a mapping between them. M1 is a PMOS at the first position, and I'm starting from there.

I'm working out which pipeline transistors correspond to the labeled ones in the image, comparing their positions and types. M1 lines up with M6, and M2 with M4, based on their coordinates. I'm now checking whether M4 is the PMOS sitting near image M12, and sorting out the arrow directions on M11 and M12.

I'm checking the mirrored pair M11 and M12 and noting that both arrows point toward their channels, so both are PMOS. That makes pipeline M4 correspond to image M12 and M5 to M11. The source and drain nets I'd assigned to M5 look wrong, so I'm going to recheck which net its source should actually connect to.

I'm verifying the source and drain connections for M1 and M3 against the image. M1's drain and gate both sit on net1, which matches the diode connection to M6, but M3's gate is wired to VDD when it should share M6's gate net.

I'm reviewing the pin assignments on M2 and M4, where the labels don't match the device geometry. The source and drain nets on the pipeline's M2 look swapped, and its gate is tied to net3 when it should be net1. I'm fixing that and making M4's source the tail net, net3.

I'm now checking the M4 terminals: the drain should connect down to M22's drain and the node feeding C1 and M5's gate, while the source at the top is still tied to VDD when it should be the tail net. I still need to work out what the gate is actually tied to.

I'm settling on VINP as the gate for M4 and reconsidering M5, which seems to need its source on the tail net. I'm also going through the shared net4 and listing everything tied to it, since the connections look tangled.

I'm now splitting the shared net4 into two separate nodes: one for the M12 drain side, and a new netA for the M11 and M21 drains plus the M21 and M22 gates. Next I'm fixing M5's connections, with its drain going to netA and its source moving to the tail net3.

I'm going back over the remaining pin assignments on M4, M7, and M8, plus the net labels on M6, C1, and R1, which all seem to check out. M9 and M10 map onto image M8 and M7, and I'm confirming the drains and gates there, along with the I1 output at net6. The new VINP net for M4's gate still needs to be confirmed as tied to the M12 gate line.

I'm confirming that M5's gate is tied to VINN, which is already correct.
